question: Which player has participated in the highest number of winning matches and which player has participated in the highest number of losing matches, considering only matches where they actually played (excluding null entries) and where their team won or lost (excluding draws)?
sql:
-- Final query: return both the player with most wins and most losses
WITH player_matches AS (
  SELECT 
    p.player_api_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal AND p.team_side = 'home' THEN 'win'
      WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal AND p.team_side = 'away' THEN 'loss'
      WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal AND p.team_side = 'away' THEN 'win'
      WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal AND p.team_side = 'home' THEN 'loss'
      ELSE NULL
    END as result
  FROM Match m
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS player_api_id, 'home' AS team_side UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_2, 'home' UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_3, 'home' UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_4, 'home' UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_5, 'home' UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_6, 'home' UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_7, 'home' UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_8, 'home' UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_9, 'home' UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_10, 'home' UNION ALL
    SELECT home_player_11, 'home' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_1, 'away' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_2, 'away' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_3, 'away' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_4, 'away' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_5, 'away' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_6, 'away' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_7, 'away' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_8, 'away' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_9, 'away' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_10, 'away' UNION ALL
    SELECT away_player_11, 'away'
  ) p ON TRUE
  WHERE p.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal OR m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal)
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    player_api_id,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS win_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS loss_count
  FROM player_matches
  GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT p.player_name FROM player_stats ps JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE ps.win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM player_stats)) AS most_winning_player,
  (SELECT ps.win_count FROM player_stats ps WHERE ps.win_count = (SELECT MAX(win_count) FROM player_stats)) AS most_winning_matches,
  (SELECT p.player_name FROM player_stats ps JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE ps.loss_count = (SELECT MAX(loss_count) FROM player_stats)) AS most_losing_player,
  (SELECT ps.loss_count FROM player_stats ps WHERE ps.loss_count = (SELECT MAX(loss_count) FROM player_stats)) AS most_losing_matches
